violation_type.title: Plan to Handle Transportation Emergencies (26 TAC §746.5619)
violation_type.typical_finding: There was no plan to handle transportation emergencies.

finding_variants.text: There was no plan to handle transportation emergencies.
Operation did not have a plan to handle transportation emergencies.
A written plan to handle transportation emergencies was unavailable at the time of inspection.
The transportation van did not have a full emergency plan that discussed supervision, contacting emegergency help, and vehicle evacuation.
There was no transportation emergency plan.

It was determined in an investgiation that the operation's plan for transportation emergencies did not include necessary information, such as how to handle emergency   breakdowns and accidents, including vehicle evacuation procedures, supervision of the children, and contacting emergency help.
